validation_ack.reason: The 164,367,122 PMHMETD I shares were distributed and listed on 24 Dec 2021 (so shares_out stores the 4,602,279,422 listed shares, AR2021 PDF p. 18), but the audited FS booked the proceeds as 'Dana setoran modal' and computed basic EPS Rp14.46 on 4,437,912,300 shares (FS2022 Note 34, PDF p. 109 of https://www.nobubank.com/documents/383/1_Bank_Nationalnobu_GA_31_Des_2022.pdf): 14.46 x 4,437,912,300 = Rp64.2bn = reported profit. Real share-count timing difference, not a data error.

PMHMETD II (+680,999,353 shares, Feb 2023) and PMHMETD III (+2,195,165,124 shares, Aug 2023): FY2023 basic EPS Rp23.05 uses a weighted average of 6,141,180,964 shares (FS2023 Note 33, PDF p. 118 of https://www.nobubank.com/documents/713/Bank_Nationalnobu_GA_31_Des_2023.pdf): 23.05 x 6,141,180,964 = Rp141.6bn = reported profit; FY-end shares are 7,478,443,899.

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document was downloaded directly from www.nobubank.com (no bot protection). URLs of the form https://www.nobubank.com/documents/<id>/<file> 302-redirect to https://storage.googleapis.com/web-nobu-prod/documents/<file> (the bank's own storage bucket). AR2023 and AR2025 are published only as .zip files containing one PDF; their source_url is the zip and loc names the PDF inside. sources.md lists every file.

ENTITY / BASIS: Nobu has no subsidiaries, so its audited financial statements are stand-alone ('Laporan Keuangan', not 'konsolidasian'). Money figures carry basis 'consolidated' because they are the entity's only, complete FS (equity attributable = total equity; no NCI). Ratios are OJK ratios from the 31-Dec published reports (bank = whole entity) and carry basis 'bank_only'.

PUBLISHED-REPORT TEXT LAYERS: the one-page OJK published reports contain overlapping hidden text (e.g. Dec-2025: KPMM 22,57%/22,49%, ROE 13,17%, Modal Inti 3.918.334 under the visible 22,29%, 13,07%, 3.906.315). Every value taken from a published report was read from the page rendered with pdftoppm, not from pdftotext alone; visible values agree with AR2025's 5-year ratio table.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-2026: three rights issues (PMHMETD I ex 2021-12-08 27:1 at Rp1,205; PMHMETD II ex 2023-02-10 81:12 at Rp592; PMHMETD III ex 2023-08-08 142:59 at Rp410). No stock split, reverse split or bonus issue (AR2025 PDF pp. 21-23 and p. 85 chronology). Earlier private placements (PMTHMETD I 4 Sep 2014, PMTHMETD II 2 Feb 2016, Rp790) are before 2019. None of the rights ex-dates is before 2020-12-31, so fy.2019.year_end_price is not required.

NOT CORPORATE ACTIONS (for the record): (1) Hanwha Life Insurance Co., Ltd bought 2,991,377,559 existing shares (40%) from PT Prima Cakrawala Sentosa, PT Putera Mulia Indonesia, PT Multipolar, PT Star Pacific, PT Inti Anugerah Pratama, PT Ciptadana Capital and PT Lenox Pasifik Investama (deed 30 Jun 2025; FS2025 Note 22 PDF pp. 97-98) and became controlling shareholder - no new shares. (2) The planned merger with PT Bank MNC Internasional Tbk (BABP; PT MNC Land held 9.99% of NOBU at end-2024) was called off: OJK said on 22 Nov 2025 that it was halted (news: https://finansial.bisnis.com/read/20251122/90/1930838/fix-ojk-ungkap-merger-nobu-mnc-bank-babp-resmi-batal); FS2025 Note 43 (PDF p. 168) only says the bank is 'exploring' a business combination under the bank-consolidation POJK; no merger shares were issued. (3) Share buyback in 2026: 5,632,400 treasury shares (Rp3,015 juta) by 30 Jun 2026, unchanged at 30 Sep 2026 (registry report); none in 2020-2025 (AR2025 p. 153). (4) Dematerialisation notice of 28 Oct 2026 concerns the 74,784,439 scrip shares (1.00%) held by PT Putera Mulia Indonesia that are not listed on IDX.

YEAR-END PRICES ARE NULL FOR EVERY FY: all NOBU annual reports print quarterly high/low/'penutupan' with the footnote that these are AVERAGES over the quarter; market caps in the same tables are mostly average-price x shares (non-integer per share). Printed Q4 'penutupan': 2020 826 (AR2020; AR2021 also has a second, inconsistent Q4-2020 row with 825), 2021 710, 2022 568, 2023 762, 2024 662, 2025 511. No bank document gives the actual last-session close. A price reviewer must not use these as 31-Dec closes; rights-factor checks for the 2021 and 2023 rights issues need another documented close.

FY2021 SHARE COUNT: PMHMETD I shares were distributed/listed on 24 Dec 2021, but the audited FS show 4,437,912,300 issued shares at 31 Dec 2021 (proceeds in 'Dana setoran modal' Rp193,167 juta until registration in 2022). shares_out stores the 4,602,279,422 listed shares (AR2021 share table), EPS stays as reported (validation_ack eps_shares:2021).

DIVIDENDS: NOBU has paid no cash dividend out of any FY2019-FY2025 profit; each AGMS retained the full net income (FY2019: AGMS 24 Jul 2020; FY2020: 27 Aug 2021; FY2021: 14 Jul 2022; FY2022: 15 Jun 2023; FY2023: 14 Jun 2024 per FS2024 Note 24; FY2024: 20 Jun 2025; FY2025: 12 Jun 2026). No interim dividend in 2026 (9M2026 report 'Dividen -'). Hence no dividend records and payout_ratio 0 for FY2020-FY2025.

AR HIGHLIGHT INCONSISTENCIES (audited FS used instead): AR2025 PDF p. 16 total equity 2025 4.182.876 (FS 4,168,262; the AR figure does not balance); 'Dana Masyarakat' 2023 17.854.872 (FS 17,875,533); AR2025 p. 17 EPS 2021 14,42 (FS 14.46). New-share listing dates differ between AR2025 p. 22-23 (28 Feb / 22 Aug 2023) and p. 85 (23 Feb / 24 Aug 2023). The FS sections inside AR2019 and AR2020 carry a 'Final Draft/March 27, 2019' footer; their FY2019/FY2020 figures equal the audited published reports of 31 Dec 2019/2020.

RATIOS: FY2020-FY2025 KPMM, NPL gross/net, ROA, ROE, NIM, BOPO, CIR, LDR from each year's 31-Dec published report (as originally printed; for FY2021-FY2025 every one except CIR also appears, identical, in AR2025's 5-year table). CASA from the AR ratio tables. NPL coverage only for FY2025 (222%, results press release 1 Apr 2026). LaR and cost of credit are not disclosed for any FY. The 9M2026 report's new 'Kredit Kualitas Rendah (KKR)' line is stored as interim lar.

INTERIM 9M2026: from the OJK published report of 30 Sep 2026 (the bank publishes full interim FS only at June). It compares the balance sheet with 31 Dec 2025, so 30 Sep 2025 loans/deposits come from the 30 Sep 2025 report. Deposits = giro + tabungan + deposito as printed (format has no subtotal). shares_out from the BAE registry report of 30 Sep 2026 (net of 5,632,400 treasury shares).
LOGO: rebrand effective 15 Jun 2026 (red lion 'NOBU NATIONAL BANK' -> green 'nobu' wordmark; announcement page and press release of 23 Jun 2026). AR2025 still shows the old logo. See logo/SOURCE.md.

SELF-CHECK eps x shares_out vs net_profit_attr: 2020 +0.01%, 2021 +3.68% (acked), 2022 -0.02%, 2023 +21.79% (acked), 2024 -0.01%, 2025 -0.00%. FY2021-FY2025 loans and deposits equal AR2025's 5-year table (PDF p. 16) except the 2023 deposit figure noted above.
